Both changes are done and verified. Here's the gate report.

| `Store.low_stock(threshold)` — skus below threshold, qty asc, ties by sku | `inventory/store.py` → `Store.low_stock` |
| a test that fails before the change and passes after | `tests/test_store.py` (7 new tests) |
| the error path (overdraw, missing sku) | `Store.remove` raises; `test_remove_overdraw_raises_and_keeps_quantity`, `test_remove_missing_sku_raises` |
| the doc line | docstrings updated in `store.py` |
| new dependency | none |
